english.title: Fail to comply with a local authority notice requiring the raising of a chimney and flue, adjoining
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[required to build up chimneys and flues]_
(B)_[the owner of a building adjoining another building upon which chimneys and flues were required to be built up]_
(C)_[the owner of a building adjoining another building upon which chimneys and flues were required to be built and having served a counter-notice]_
(D)_[the occupier of a building adjoining another building upon which chimneys and flues were required to be built up]
(E)_[the occupier of a building adjoining another building upon which chimneys and flues were required to be built and having served a counter-notice]_

in accordance with section 73(1) of the Building Act 1984 and having been served with a notice in accordance with

(F)_[section 73(1)(i)]_
(G)_[section 73(1)(ii)]_

of the Act, failed to comply with that notice in that **(..SPECIFY NON-COMPLIANCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 73(3) of the Building Act 1984.
